Our services

A full range of exterior cleaning for homeowners, property managers, and businesses. Professional equipment, careful methods, every job.

Window Cleaning

Streak-free glass inside and out, including screens and sills. A clearer view and a brighter space.

Pressure Washing

Dirt, mold, and stains lifted from driveways, walkways, patios, and building exteriors. Surfaces look years newer, without damage.

Gutter Cleaning

Leaves, debris, and buildup cleared so water drains properly. Clean gutters protect your roof, walls, and foundation.

Roof Cleaning

Moss, algae, and debris safely removed. Your roof looks better and lasts longer.

Solar Panel Cleaning

Dust and grime cut into output. We clean panels carefully so they absorb more sunlight and work at full strength.

Water-Fed Pole Cleaning

High and hard-to-reach windows cleaned from the ground with a water-fed pole system. Safer, and it reaches spots a ladder can't.

Frequently asked questions

What types of properties do you clean?

Houses, rentals, commercial buildings, and post-construction sites across our service area.

Do you use safe cleaning products?

Yes. Our products are tough on dirt and safe around people, pets, and plants.

One-time job or recurring service?

Both. Get a single deep clean, or set up regular visits, whatever fits your needs.

How long does a job take?

It depends on the size and condition of the property. We give you an estimated time when we quote the job. Most take a few hours.

Do I need to be home?

Up to you. We can work while you're there or while you're out, as long as we can reach the areas being cleaned.

What if I'm not happy with the work?

Tell us within 24 hours and we'll come back and make it right.

Do you bring your own equipment?

Yes. We arrive fully equipped with professional supplies and gear.

Privacy Policy

Effective October 13, 2026. Brightwing Window Cleaning ("Brightwing," "we," "us") is owned and operated by Ayton Hesterman and Max Chelin. This policy explains what we collect and how we use it.

Information we collect

We collect the details you give us when you request a quote or contact us: your name, phone number, email address, service address, and any notes about the job. If you call or text us, we keep a record of that conversation so we can follow up.

How we use your information

  • To respond to your quote request and answer your questions.
  • To schedule, prepare for, and carry out the services you book.
  • To follow up about your job, send reminders, and request feedback.
  • To keep records for our own business and tax purposes.

Calls and texts

If you give us your phone number, we may call or text you about your quote and your service. Message and data rates may apply. You can opt out of texts at any time by replying STOP or by telling us directly, and we will still be able to reach you about a job already booked.

Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share it only with people who help us run the business (for example, a scheduling or payment tool), and only as needed to do that work, or when the law requires it.

Retention and security

We keep your information for as long as we need it to serve you and meet our legal and tax obligations, then dispose of it. We take reasonable steps to protect it, though no method of storage is completely secure.

Your choices

You can ask us what information we have about you, ask us to correct or delete it, or opt out of marketing messages. Contact us using the details below.

Children

Our services and this site are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version will always be posted here with its effective date.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Call or text 510-570-6099, or email brightwinghomecare@gmail.com.

Terms of Service

Effective October 13, 2026. These terms apply when you request or receive services from Brightwing Window Cleaning.

Our services

We provide window cleaning, pressure washing, gutter cleaning, roof cleaning, solar panel cleaning, and water-fed pole cleaning for homes and businesses. Any quote we give is an estimate based on the information you provide; the final price may change once we see the property in person, and we will tell you before any extra cost is added.

Scheduling and access

We will agree on a date and time with you. Please make sure we can reach the areas to be cleaned, including gates, side yards, and power or water access where needed. If we cannot access the property at the scheduled time, we may need to reschedule.

Cancellations and rescheduling

Let us know as early as you can if you need to cancel or move your appointment. If you cancel on the day of your scheduled service, a fee of 50% of the quoted price is due, because that time was reserved for you and can no longer be filled. We may reschedule for weather or safety reasons, and we will contact you if that happens.

Payment

Payment is due when the work is complete unless we agree otherwise in writing. We will tell you the accepted payment methods when we confirm your booking.

Satisfaction

If you are not happy with any part of our work, tell us within 24 hours and we will come back and re-clean the area in question at no extra charge.

Property and pre-existing conditions

We treat every property with care. We are not responsible for pre-existing damage or wear, such as old or failing window seals, cracked glass, loose screens, worn paint, or oxidation that cleaning may reveal or that cannot be removed. If you know of fragile or damaged areas, please point them out before we start. If you believe we caused damage, tell us within 24 hours so we can inspect it.

Window tracks: standard service includes a basic wipe-down of the window tracks. A full track detail, for tracks that are heavily built up with dirt, soil, or debris, is a separate paid add-on. Without the full track detail, heavily soiled tracks may not come fully clean, because a wipe-down alone cannot remove deep buildup.

Safety and weather

Your safety and ours comes first. We may decline or pause work, or reschedule, when conditions are unsafe, including high wind, storms, ice, or unstable surfaces.

Limitation of liability

To the extent allowed by law, our responsibility for any claim related to our services is limited to the amount you paid for the job in question. We are not liable for indirect or incidental losses.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the State of [your state].

Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. The current version will always be posted here with its effective date.
